edits.why: Metadata and accessibility links currently precede the summary, pushing the actual content below the fold on mobile screens.
edits.how: Move the breadcrumbs, publication date, audio player, and font-size controls below the opening summary and key stats box.

edits.why: This section contains 510 words and a 15-row table, making it an overly long scroll for mobile readers.
edits.how: Break the section into two separate H2 sub-topics, placing the large table in its own subsection.

edits.how: Split paragraph 20 into three shorter paragraphs at logical sentence breaks.
